title: schoenoplectus supinus subsp. hallii
intro: Schoenoplectus supinus subsp. hallii, commonly known as Hall's bulrush or Hall's cattail, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the cattail family (Typhaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hall's bulrush include mucilage, which helps soothe and protect irritated mucous membranes, and its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
